name: wcag
description: Audits web pages, PDFs, documents, and mobile apps against WCAG 2.2 and fixes what it finds when asked. Loads as seven skills.

interface.shortDescription: Accessibility auditing and remediation against WCAG 2.2.
interface.longDescription: Seven skills covering web pages, PDFs, office documents, and mobile apps. Audit mode reads and reports without changing anything. Remediation is a separate, explicit request, with rules for what can be fixed automatically and what needs the content owner. Bundles scripts for contrast ratios, static HTML checks, axe-core scans, PDF structure, and report generation.
